_comment: Loan-success-score component weights, per position. Unlike data/score_weights.json (permanent transfers), there's no value_for_money or resale_profit component: most loans carry no real fee (the packaged fee is 0 even when a real loan fee was agreed - see fetch_transfer_types.py), and a loan doesn't end in a sale of its own. playing_time is weighted heavily across every position - whether the loan actually delivered game time is usually the central question a loan gets judged on, independent of how well the player performed when they did play. Shared by scripts/build_dataset.py (computes the label) and app/main.py (labels the 'why this score' explanation). Each position row must sum to 1.0.
